title: What's New in Manufacturing: Costing (2025 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Stock Keeping Unit Production Routing and Costing
Demo: Activating SKU Costing and Production Orders

features.name: Production bill of material and routing on stock keeping unit
features.description: Ability to define production bill of material or routing on individual stock keeping units to handle product variants or location-specific production differences. This impacts the standard cost calculation for items produced for specific variants or locations.

features.name: Standard cost per stock keeping unit
features.description: Standard cost calculation that is carefully copied from the stock keeping unit rather than the item card, allowing different costs for the same item based on variant or location.
caveats: Only applies when stock keeping unit has routing or bill of material defined

features.name: Calculate production standard cost function
features.description: New function to calculate production standard cost at the stock keeping unit level, enabling accurate cost determination for variant and location-specific production.

features.name: Non-inventory cost inclusion in production cost calculation
features.description: Capability to include non-inventory costs into the production cost calculation, with new columns for rolled up material non-inventory cost and single level material non-inventory cost visible on cost shares page and production order statistics.

features.name: Cost shares page enhancements
features.description: Cost shares page now displays total cost and components including new columns for rolled up material non-inventory cost and single level material non-inventory cost.
